item.title: The 10 Most Important Energy Stories of 2025
item.description: If 2025 taught us anything, it was that energy markets remain governed by fundamentals, not slogans. item.title: Could the Next Solar Flare Cripple Modern Technology?
item.description: The Van Allen radiation belts are massive, doughnut-shaped regions of charged particles trapped by Earth's magnetic field. Now, the Van Allen radiation belts are "fully charged," according to space weather observer Stefan Burns. item.title: Oil Prices Open 2026 Higher as Geopolitical Risk Rises
